card.name: Word endings before punctuation
card.fires_on: The last piece of a noun just before a comma, period, semicolon or closing bracket, such as 'is' in diaphoresis, 'overdose' after 'any', or 'elderly' after 'the'. It marks a point where the phrase is complete.

modes.label: End of diaphoresis
modes.description: The final 'is' of 'diaphoresis' in lists of signs of autonomic instability.

modes.description: A complete noun like overdose or elderly right before a period or semicolon.

card.writes: It suppresses punctuation such as commas, periods and brackets, so the next token is less likely to be punctuation.
card.plain: It fires on the last word of a phrase when a comma or period would normally follow, and it holds back that punctuation.
